hints.tr: Kesikli dağılımda `sf(x)` = P(X > x); `x`'in kendisi dahil değil.
hints.en: In a discrete distribution `sf(x)` = P(X > x); `x` itself is not included.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
from scipy import stats


def at_least(n, p, k):
    return round(float(stats.binom(n, p).sf(k - 1)), 4)

print(at_least(10, 0.5, 7))
print(at_least(20, 0.1, 1))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
from scipy import stats


def at_least(n, p, k):
    return round(float(stats.binom(n, p).sf(k - 1)), 4)

print(at_least(10, 0.5, 7))
print(at_least(20, 0.1, 1))
```
